summary: Kazia Therapeutics filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered offering of American Depositary Shares (ADSs), each representing 500 ordinary shares, together with pre-funded warrants, Series A warrants (exercise price 115% of offering price), and Series B warrants (exercise price 125%). The ADSs trade on Nasdaq under KZIA; last sale was $14.60 on August 26, 2026. The offering is a capital raise, not a special situation. Underwriters include Leerink Partners and Guggenheim Securities. The deal is a routine securities offering with no premium, board recommendation, or special-situation mechanics. What to watch: offering pricing and terms when finalized.
